image.alt: A plate of twelve small geometric stone microliths - trapezoid, crescent and triangle shapes, and slender backed blades, each one to three centimetres long - laid in a row against a printed centimetre scale.

bone.alt: Slender pointed bone tools incised with a repeating zigzag pattern cut into the shaft, lying on a dark surface.

beads.alt: Round flat ostrich-eggshell disc beads, each pierced in the centre, drilled and polished, scattered together in a small group.

shelter.alt: A fieldworker kneeling inside a shallow cave shelter, brushing the sediment floor gently with a trowel and brush, in a rural rock landscape.
